stories.title: Police: Parma baby shower shooting leaves 3 dead, including unborn child's father, grandfather
stories.summary: Police say the unborn baby's 19-year-old father and 45-year-old maternal grandfather were among those found dead at the scene.

stories.title: I-90 reopens in downtown Cleveland as ODOT crews finish construction work ahead of schedule
stories.summary: ODOT District 12 said the construction crew finished work on a portion of ODOT's I-90 Central Interchange Project more than 32 hours ahead of schedule.

stories.title: How are Cleveland travelers impacted by Delta's flight delays in Atlanta? Checking flights at Cleveland Hopkins International Airport
stories.summary: Has your flight into or out of Cleveland Hopkins International Airport been affected by Delta's issues on Sunday? Check your flight status here.

stories.title: North Royalton firefighter injured in fatal Broadview Heights house fire returns home from hospital
stories.summary: Firefighter Andrew Protsman returned home Sunday after battling a Broadview Heights fire that left him hospitalized. The same fire took the life of Ryan Milligan.

stories.title: Cleveland native Tom Jackson, former Broncos star and 'Sunday NFL Countdown' analyst, dead at 75
stories.summary: Jackson, a Cleveland native and former John Adams High School football star, played 14 seasons for the Denver Broncos before a 32-year career as an ESPN analyst.

stories.title: Parma police identify 2 victims in deadly baby shower shooting
stories.summary: Leasia England, 17, and Jayson Lamont Townsend, 45, were among the three people found dead after the shooting at a Parma event venue Saturday night.

stories.title: Powerball winner hits jackpot worth $114 million: See where the lucky lottery ticket was sold and check the winning numbers for the Nov. 21 drawing
stories.summary: The jackpot now resets to $20 million for the next Powerball drawing.

stories.title: 8-year-old boy killed after being struck by vehicle in Akron, police say
stories.summary: The boy was crossing Massillon Road when he was struck by a vehicle. Akron police said they do not believe the driver was impaired or speeding

stories.title: Winning Mega Millions numbers for the $629 million jackpot on Friday, Nov. 20, 2026: See all the prizes hit in Ohio
stories.summary: The jackpot now jumps to $645 million for the next drawing.

stories.title: Ohio's bill banning child marriage will likely not pass, according to Ohio Senate president
stories.summary: Ohio's attempt to ban child marriage faces uncertainty as the General Assembly winds down, with Senate President Rob McColley citing Republican caucus hesitations.

stories.title: Massillon football stars Brayton and Brydon Feister cleared to play after court blocks OHSAA's suspension, but Tigers fall to Bishop Watterson 22-5
stories.summary: Even with an appeals court allowing Brayton and Brydon Feister back on the field, Massillon Washington still lost to Bishop Watterson in the D-II regional finals.

stories.title: James Harden scores 51 points to propel Cleveland Cavaliers past Indiana Pacers 128-119
stories.summary: James Harden scored 51 points as the Cavaliers defeated the Pacers 128-119 in an NBA Cup game. It was the 18-year veteran guard's 26th 50-point game.
